findings.desc: quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1855 — optional non-boolean param rendering changed from [--k=value] (brackets signal optional) to --k=value (no brackets). The [...] convention for optional arguments was present on main. This is a help-text behavioral change, not a pure string translation: optional non-boolean params now look required in the Usage line. The story scope is text-only / no-logic-change.

CHK-003:edge:0 (must): verifier uses ok(ref, true, ...) hardcoded pass — the intent requires verifying Phase-2 changes were comment-only (no logic lines changed), but Phase 1 and Phase 2 were squashed into one commit (ad6212a65) leaving no Phase-1 baseline to diff against. The note claims build + behavior-sensitive integrity cover it, but those proxies do not prove comment-only scope. Evidence should be a waiver with explicit explanation of the Phase-1/2 squash, or an alternative mechanical check showing no non-comment/non-describe-string lines changed.
